1.w: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, do not be silent!

2.w: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful, they have opened against me—they speak against me with a tongue of lies;

3.w: and with words of hatred they surround me, and they fight me without cause.

4.w: In exchange for my love they accuse me, and I [am] of prayer;

5.w: and they set against me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

6.w: Appoint a wicked man over him, and let an adversary stand at his right hand.

7.w: In his being judged, may he go forth [as] wicked, and let his prayer come to be as sin.

8.w: May his days be few; may another take his position!

9.w: May his sons be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

10.w: And let his sons wander continually and beg, and let them seek sustenance from their desolate places!

11.w: Let the creditor lay a snare for all that [is] unto him, and let strangers plunder his labour.

12.w: None shall there be for him extending kindness, and none shall there be showing favor to his fatherless.

13.w: Let his posterity be for cutting off; in the next generation let their name be blotted out!

14.w: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered to YHWH, and the sin of his mother not be blotted out.

15.w: Let them be before YHWH continually, that He may cut off from the earth their memory!

16.w: Because that he has not remembered to do kindness, and he pursued the poor and needy man, and the broken of heart to kill [him].

17.w: And he loved cursing, and let it come to him; and he did not delight in blessing, and let it be far from him!

18.w: And he clothed himself with cursing as his garment, and it came in like the water within him, and like the oil into his bones!

19.w: May it be for him like the garment wrapped about him, and continually as a belt he girds on.

20.w: May this be the reward of my accusers from YHWH, and of those speaking evil against my soul!

21.w: But You, O YHWH my Lord, may you act with me for the sake of Your name; because of the goodness of Your loving devotion, deliver me!

22.w: For I [am] poor and needy, and my heart is pierced within me.

23.w: Like a shadow in its lengthening, I am gone; I am shaken off like the locust.

24.w: My knees wobble from fasting, and my flesh has failed of fatness.

25.w: And I have become an object of scorn for them; they see me; they shake their head.

26.w: Help me, O YHWH my God; save me according to Your loving devotion,

27.w: that they may know that this [is] Your hand; You, O YHWH, have done it!

28.w: They may curse, but You will bless; may they rise up, and be put to shame, and may Your servant rejoice!

29.w: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace, and may they be covered with their shame as the robe.

30.w: I will confess YHWH greatly with my mouth, and in the midst of the multitudes I will praise Him.

31.w: For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save [him] from those judging his soul.
